name: פַּתְרֻסִים
summary: The Pathrusim, the people of the Egyptian region of Pathros, placed by Genesis and Chronicles between the Naphtuhim and the Casluhim among the descendants of Mizraim. The gentilic is formed from the place name Pathros.

evidence.note: Mizraim is the subject of יָלַד, and וְאֶת introduces the Pathrusim as one of the peoples he fathered.
The parallel genealogy places the Pathrusim immediately before the Casluhim.
The related place name appears in אֶרֶץ פַּתְרוֹס, the land of Pathros, among the places in Egypt where Judeans lived.

note: Moved from the former word entry `ppaterusiym`. פתרס recorded the consonantal stem of the gentilic. No Hebrew verbal derivation is established.
